title: Rough cleaning

blocks.what_we_do: Remove very poorly called wells first, then very poorly called sites.
blocks.why: Gross failures distort later missingness and heterozygosity summaries. We first remove samples with over 10% missing genotypes, recompute on the survivors, and remove variants with over 10% missingness. Order matters: removing poor wells can improve a site's apparent call rate. This is an initial screen, not the final 98% call-rate rule.
blocks.command:
```{r s3-1}
input <- guided_path(cfg, "2.8")
rough <- guided_path(cfg, "3.1", "samples")
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", input, "--mind", "0.10", "--make-pgen", "--out", rough))
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", rough, "--geno", "0.10", "--make-pgen", "--out", guided_path(cfg, "3.1")))
ops <- guided_replay_lists(cfg, "3.1", "2.8")
guided_register(cfg, "3.1", "2.8", 2013, 296360, operations = ops)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s2-8_state --mind 0.10 --make-pgen --out results/guided/s3-1_samples --threads 2 --memory 2048
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s3-1_samples --geno 0.10 --make-pgen --out results/guided/s3-1_state --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

`--mind 0.10` removes wells above 10% missingness. `--geno 0.10` removes sites above 10% missingness in the remaining wells. These are deliberately separate calls. `--pfile` selects the input native fileset; `--make-pgen` saves a new state; `--out` sets its prefix. The helper adds `--threads 2` and `--memory 2048`, limiting threads and workspace MiB.
blocks.expected_result:
Three wells and 150 variants removed: 2,013 samples and 296,360 variants remain.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.what_this_check_can_reveal: Failed wells and gross probe failures. The procedure does not identify the biological or technical cause by itself.
blocks.quick_check:
Why do we recalculate variant missingness after removing very poor wells?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

Poor wells can make otherwise usable sites appear to fail.

</details>
